description: Show an earlier version under a SECOND address without touching the live site — use this whenever the user wants to look before deciding. Returns a url; the pod needs a few seconds, so a first request may fail — retry once. Pass `stop: true` (without `image`) to tear the preview down again; it costs nothing once stopped.

image.description: Image of the version to show, from runzero_list_versions

stop.description: Remove the preview instead of creating one

name: runzero_preview_version
title: Preview earlier version
